author: oracle
purpose: Settle Lesson 19 / Standing Duty 0d empirically: is the Sharadar-sector cluster key (which groups KLIC+PAY+QTWO into 45.78% of equity) the factor that actually co-moves? Directive D4's 40% correlation-cluster cap is only as good as the key it is given.

data.source: Sharadar SEP daily closeadj via shared.sharadar.fetch_sep_bars; SPY daily from Robinhood get_equity_historicals (SPY is not in SEP)
data.market_adjustment: OLS residual vs SPY per name

findings: PAY~QTWO residual r=+0.44, t=+3.06 SIGNIFICANT. The operator's D4 motivating exhibit is CONFIRMED by measurement, not merely by two coincident 3% days. Combined weight 34.39% of equity.

KLIC~TPC residual r=+0.44, t=+3.08 SIGNIFICANT — a SECOND real cluster, and it SPANS two Sharadar sectors (Technology / Industrials), so a sector-keyed cap is structurally blind to it. Combined weight 29.66%.
KLIC~QTWO residual r=-0.45, t=-3.13 SIGNIFICANTLY NEGATIVE — yet Sharadar puts both in 'Technology'. The sector key does not merely over-group; on this pair it is INVERTED.
PAY~TPC residual r=-0.34, t=-2.28 significantly negative.

Net: the 45.78% 'Technology' bucket the 40% cap would bind on is composed of two significantly ANTI-correlated sub-groups, while the genuine second cluster (KLIC+TPC) is invisible to it. Capping Technology would be a risk control applied to the wrong basket.
theme_mechanism: KLIC+TPC share AI/datacenter CAPITAL EXPENDITURE, not a GICS sector: KLIC sells back-end advanced-packaging equipment into the AI buildout, TPC builds the data-center/power infrastructure. This is NOT read off the correlation — the 2026-08-19 belief entry independently split TPC's E&C peer set into 'AI-capex builders' vs 'non-AI E&C' BEFORE this study was run, and the measurement corroborates that earlier, independent reading.
caveats: n=42 daily returns over ONE regime (07-09..09-08). SE(r)~0.154; these are 2-3 SE effects, not settled facts.

Reading a THEME label off a correlation is a mild form of fitting. The economic mechanism and the independent 08-19 peer-set split are what make it more than curve-fit; the tags remain a HYPOTHESIS the next window can refute.
No cluster exceeds the 40% cap under the proposed tags. That is an OUTPUT of the study, not its goal, and it must not be used as evidence the tags are right.
This study licenses NO trade. It is a Stage-4 SIZING input for the next funding round only.
disposition: NOT hand-patched into any dossier, cluster_key override, or sizer edit (F-rules / the standing refusal to fake a Stage-3 input). The tags are to be threaded through make_upside_dossier(theme=...) at the dossier rebuild, where the 40% cap will then key off the measured factor. Duty 0d is now EVIDENCED rather than asserted; it is not yet APPLIED.
